scientific_integrity: Full analytic counting and limiting proof; finite checker supplementary. No independent validation or external mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Regular coordinate cross-polytopes only; invariant random affine hyperplanes conditional on intersection; face-vector classification is not full combinatorial face-lattice classification. Asymptotic theorem addresses finitely many fixed face ranks and has no quantified rate. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Exact face-vector law for motion-invariant affine sections of cross-polytopes
